metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the new moon, a leaf that reversed the two days, and Two Gentlemen in the gown you had.

yesterday: Saturday night had Friday as the Shrew and Saturday as Two Gentlemen. The leaf has reversed them. Today was Two Gentlemen, tomorrow is the Shrew, and you are in both. No part was named.
You copied no page for Saturday supper.
Last Saturday Quiney asked a supper and left the day open. The August two pounds are still out, and the brief has paid nothing.
The tally with Kemp is still open until he shuts it himself.
